name: JDM Supply LLC
old_description: We sale NEW & USED Circuit Breakers, Motor Control, Starters, Contactors, Panels, Fuses, & More!!
about:
JDM Supply LLC is based in Mesa, Arizona, and was founded in 2002. The company operates as a distributor of new and used electrical equipment, serving customers through an online store and a physical location in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies a range of electrical components including circuit breakers, motor controls, starters, contactors, electrical panels, panelboard switches, and fuses. It maintains an inventory of both new and used items and offers emergency delivery within the Phoenix metro area without additional fees. The business operates six days a week, with hours from 6:30 AM to 4 PM on weekdays and 8 AM to noon on Saturdays.

JDM Supply serves electrical contractors, industrial maintenance departments, and commercial facilities that require replacement or upgrade components. The company emphasizes building long-term relationships and provides support for urgent needs, such as emergency breakdowns, without charging opening fees.

The company states that it was started to solve customer problems without penalizing them with extra fees during emergencies. Its differentiators include free local delivery, no emergency opening charges, and a commitment to going the extra mile for customers.
